Verdict: needs_changes. Implementer target declaration is present and matches `{Repo, Env: dev, Project: (none)}`; `target_context.commands_run` is empty, so no forbidden command shapes.

FINDING (high, correctness): Live append can proceed without the required C8 sidecar lock if `flock` fails. Evidence: [invocation_ledger.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic-canonical-discovery/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/invocation_ledger.py:325) catches `OSError`/`AttributeError`, yields, then [line 385](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic-canonical-discovery/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/invocation_ledger.py:385) opens `invocations.jsonl` anyway. That violates “acquire `<ledger>.lock` via flock BEFORE opening invocations.jsonl” and can still race a rename on stale inode. Recommendation: on append lock failure, skip/raise into the existing fail-open recorder path rather than writing unlocked.

FINDING (medium, test_coverage): C8 append lock failure is untested. Evidence: tests cover sidecar creation and compaction flock fail-closed, but no append-path test monkeypatches `fcntl.flock` to prove no unlocked append occurs. Recommendation: add an append flock-unavailable test asserting the data file is not opened/written without a held sidecar lock.

$ PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 pytest -q scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_invocation_ledger.py scripts/dontpanic_
